title: ChainRank listing row
description: A paid-listing row from chainrank.fyi. MONEY IS IN INTEGER CENTS HERE and that is deliberate: the provider's contract is `totalUsdCents`, and the UI divides by 100 at render time. This is the ONE integer minor-unit money carrier in the repo (common/money.json explains that everything else is a decimal string), and it is preserved as-is rather than converted, because converting would claim a precision the contract does not state. `lastPaidAt`/`createdAt` are provider ISO strings and stay strings.

total_usd_cents.description: Cents of USDC raised. Integer by contract; divide by 100 for display.

owner_address.description: The paying wallet's address - a public chain address, not a secret, but still S3-adjacent: expose only where the provider already does.

last_paid_at.description: Provider ISO string; NOT an instant we produced.

rank.description: Position in the provider's own ordering (DERIVED from the ordering, like the exchange row's rank).

partial.description: Fields the provider shipped that this contract does not name. The row is passed through verbatim by the sidecar rather than re-modelled, so a consumer MUST tolerate additive keys here; this property exists so the object can still be closed where the value set IS known.
